name: creations_register_download
description: Record asset egress (`creation.downloaded`) for creations about to be saved outside the platform. Editor plugins call it right before writing result files to disk. Max 8 identifiers. `originals[]` carries the file to save instead of `url`: the untouched original of an image whose `url` is a re-encode, or, with `license: true`, the licensed file of a stock item whose `url` is only its preview. `refused[]` lists stock items Magnific could not license (`reason`: `premium` = outside the plan, `session` = the user must sign in again, `unavailable` = anything else); never save their `url`, it is only that preview.

license.description: License project stock items and return their file in `originals[]` (or why not in `refused[]`). Only pass it when you write the `originals[]` file instead of `url`.

max_video_bytes.description: With `license`: largest video file the caller can place, in bytes. A licensed stock clip over it comes back as its best MP4 rendition under it.
